title: identity taxonomy v4 — causal control edges + single-write lineage (v7 doctoral review Gate MAJOR-1/-2 remediation)
supersession: v4 supersedes v3 (dated supersession; v3 file retained for audit). Changes: (1) MAJOR-1 — is_rq_sys_control_compatible now requires >=1 VALID control edge (signal actually controls the right), not two non-empty sets; (2) control_edges become first-class per-method-path records with per-edge source locator + semantics; (3) allowed signal->right relation registry (edges outside it are invalid; extending it requires a dated taxonomy supersession + adjudication); (4) v7-review §7.6 — candidate_pool_exists / selection_policy split so random-K keeps its pool fact without re-entering reward-guided selection; (5) single-write pipeline: coding v5 is GENERATED from per-paper sidecars (scripts/survey/sf_coding_generator.py), hand-editing coding is a reconciliation failure; (6) actor-identity discipline replaces the W1 group label; (7) field_evidence records bind load-bearing field values to canonical-record/TeX quotes.

fields.signal_use: must be a member of the row's signal_use
fields.decision_right: must be a member of the row's decision_rights
fields.signal_lifecycle: lifecycle at which the edge operates; only online_step/terminal edges count toward is_rq_sys_control_compatible
fields.source_locator: REQUIRED non-empty; 'canon: <quote>' = verbatim quote inside the work's canonical DFS section; 'TeX: <quote>' = verbatim quote in the pinned eprint; plus optional structural tokens (pN/Fig/Table/Algorithm/Eq/§)
fields.edge_semantics: REQUIRED one-sentence causal statement: how this signal use controls this right

control_edge_schema.validity: an edge is VALID iff signal_use∈row.signal_use AND decision_right∈row.decision_rights AND (signal_use -> decision_right) ∈ allowed_relations AND source_locator non-empty AND edge_semantics non-empty; unknown/absent evidence => no edge => not rq-sys-compatible (fail-closed)

allowed_relations_provenance.seed: v7 doctoral review §4.3 relation table (revise->retry/branch; stop_budget->stop; supply->supply/branch; route->route/tool_call; select/prune->branch when selection decides subsequent branches, terminal when only final answer)

evidence_driven_additions.justification: RTV selection determines WHICH summaries condition the next sequential iteration's refinement context (TeX 'Select-K ... selection via RTV'; canon '跨迭代状态=选中 K 摘要作精炼上下文') — selection-conditioned context construction is a causal edge, distinct from final-answer selection
tournament elimination narrows the summary set that supplies the next iteration (same mechanism as select->supply)
ATLAS explore-or-stop is ONE decision: the convergence/information-gain assessment controls both whether another explore tool call is dispatched and whether to stop (canon '独占 explore/stop 决策')
DREAM low-threshold triggers supplementary sampling m — the budget signal causes additional branching (canon '全低于低阈值补采 m')

allowed_relations_provenance.extension_discipline: new relation types require a dated taxonomy supersession with anchor row + adjudication; field-name-equality guessing forbidden (v7 review §4.3)
allowed_relations_provenance.adjudication_2026_07_19: iso-adj-A adjudicated the three anchored additions LEGIT (select->supply / prune->supply / stop_budget->tool_call), with caveat: stop_budget->tool_call is valid ONLY where dispatch and stop are one decision (ATLAS explore-or-stop); it must not be generalized to papers where they are separate decisions

derived_v4.data_access_strict_bits: all seven access booleans false AND internal_visibility==api_only
derived_v4.is_reward_guided: signal_lifecycle ∈ {online_step, terminal} AND signal_form ∈ reward_forms AND signal_use ∩ reward_uses ≠ ∅ (unchanged from v3)
derived_v4.is_s0_core_compatible: strict AND core_topology ∈ topology_policy AND core_native_modality ∈ {audio_native, omni_native} (unchanged from v3)
derived_v4.is_rq_sys_control_compatible: is_reward_guided AND control_horizon==sequential AND count(LIVE valid control_edges) >= 1, where LIVE = lifecycle==online_step OR (lifecycle==terminal AND decision_right ∈ {synthesize, stop}) — CHANGED (MAJOR-1): two non-empty sets no longer suffice; the signal must be shown to control the right. The terminal-rights restriction is the CE-v2 patch (isolated non-implementer refutation __fixture__terminal_select_branch_miscat: a whitelisted select->branch edge on a terminal final-answer tournament must not confer rq — terminal edges never license forward-step rights)
derived_v4.reward_guided_selection: selection_policy ∈ {scored_select, tournament_select} AND signal_form ∈ reward_forms — random_sample/consensus/profile_route/synthesize_all never count (v7 review §7.6: pool fact preserved without re-admitting the wrong 3/11)

killer_fixtures_contract.K1_native_audio_no_reward: audio_native strict core with no reward signal must NOT be method candidate
killer_fixtures_contract.K2_reward_tool_stop_no_pool: omni-native strict core, verifiable online reward with EVIDENCED tool_call/stop edges, no K pool — MUST be rq-sys compatible and method candidate (edges required under v4)
killer_fixtures_contract.K3_online_binary_verifiable: verifiable_outcome online signal counts as reward
killer_fixtures_contract.K4_disjoint_no_edge: MAJOR-1 killer: select-signal + memory_write-right with NO edge must NOT be rq-sys compatible (was True under v3 — the review's refuting construction)
killer_fixtures_contract.K5_fabricated_edge: MAJOR-1 killer: a fabricated select->memory_write edge is outside allowed_relations and must NOT confer rq-sys compatibility
killer_fixtures_contract.K6_terminal_only_selection: MAJOR-1 killer: final-answer selection plus an unrelated sequential right with no valid edge must NOT be rq-sys compatible
killer_fixtures_contract.P1_revise_retry: positive control: evidenced revise->retry edge yields rq-sys compatible
killer_fixtures_contract.P2_stop_budget_stop: positive control: evidenced stop_budget->stop edge yields rq-sys compatible
killer_fixtures_contract.K7_terminal_edge_forward_right: CE-v2 (non-implementer): terminal-lifecycle edge targeting a forward-step right (e.g. whitelisted select->branch on a final-answer tournament) must NOT confer rq — enforced by the LIVE-edge terminal-rights restriction; fixture lives in 2026-07-19-sf-independent-counterexamples-v2.json

single_write_pipeline.flow: per-paper sidecar (wiki/survey/sidecars/*.sidecar.json, canonical source) -> scripts/survey/sf_coding_generator.py -> coding v5 JSON (generated projection) -> reconciliation (sf_identity_taxonomy_v4_test.py V7) -> occupancy
rules: coding v5 must be byte-identical to the generator's output over the sidecar set; hand edits to coding are a reconciliation failure
the same semantic value is written ONCE (in the sidecar); derived fields are recomputed, never trusted from coding
generator output is deterministically ordered and byte-stable (repeat runs zero diff)
sidecar fulltext pin binds {ledger, id, kind, sha256} — reconciliation requires the SAME ledger row to carry id+kind+sha256; version binding is byte-level sha256
batch growth: denominators are len(rows) and unique paper_work_id counts — never hard-coded; duplicate method_path_id rejected; load-bearing rows without adjudicated_agree rejected

actor_identity_discipline.rule: coder and semantic_adjudicator are stable actor ids, never group labels (W1 forbidden); load-bearing rows require coder != semantic_adjudicator; AI actors record model + task identity; unresolved disagreements go to conflict_queue and never enter completed occupancy

actors.claude-opus-iso-adj:<task-id>: isolated adjudication agent (Opus, fresh context, non-implementer); task id recorded per adjudication

field_evidence_schema: per load-bearing field: {field, value, kind: canon|tex, quote}; reconciliation asserts value==row field AND quote appears verbatim in the work's canonical DFS section (canon) or pinned eprint TeX (tex); flipping the field without touching its evidence record is a machine-caught inconsistency; flipping both leaves a semantically unsupported pair for the independent adjudicator (documented residual)
